name: PLEASE KNOCK -before entering my room-
source:
"Nice to meet you, I'm Kuya! I'm just an ordinary university student who spends my days supporting the research of my senior, 'Nitro-senpai,' in the same lab!"

A slapstick comedy novel about seniors and juniors! Guide your senpai well and make progress in the research!
translation:
“很高兴认识你，我是空也！我只是一名普通的大学生，每天都在为同一个实验室的学长‘硝基前辈’的研究提供支持！”

一部关于前辈和后辈的闹剧喜剧小说！好好指导你的前辈，让研究取得进步！
